_note: Shared worked-example inputs for FMS engineering item 2 (product -> process -> machines): guide docs/62, tools/fmse/*.py, web/fmse2x*.js. All values are EXAMPLES. Every consumer uses exactly these inputs and the formulas in _formulas so the numbers match.

_formulas.abc: sort parts by annual volume (or revenue = volume*price if basis='revenue') descending; cumulative share; class A while cumulative share BEFORE adding the part < 80 %, B while < 95 %, else C
_formulas.jaccard: s_jk = a/(a+b+c): a = parts using machine j AND k, b+c = parts using only one of them
_formulas.slca: single linkage: join machines j,k when s_jk >= T (and s_jk > 0); cells = connected components; each part goes to the cell where it has most operations (tie -> lowest cell index)
_formulas.roc: King's rank order clustering: rows read as binary numbers (leftmost column = highest bit), sort rows descending (stable); then columns read as binary (top row = highest bit), sort descending; repeat until no change (max 20 iterations)
_formulas.efficiency: eta = q*eta1 + (1-q)*eta2, q = 0.5; eta1 = ones inside blocks / cells inside blocks; eta2 = zeros outside blocks / cells outside blocks
_formulas.it_grade: use the ISO 286-1 table it_table_um (size range by nominal D: lower < D <= upper; D <= 3 -> first range); required grade = largest k with IT_k <= tolerance width
_formulas.allowance: per-side nominal allowance of step i: z_i = z_min_i + T_(i-1)/2  (T in mm on the diameter, T_(i-1) = tolerance of the step before; for i=1 the raw-part tolerance); diameter before step i: D_(i-1) = D_i - 2*z_i (bore) ; start from the mid-tolerance final diameter
_formulas.turning: n = 1000*vc/(pi*D); vf = f*n; t_c = passes*L/vf; Pc = kc*ap*f*vc/60000 kW; M = 9550*Pc/n
_formulas.milling: n = 1000*vc/(pi*Dc); vf = fz*z*n; t_c = passes*(L + Dc)/vf; Q = ap*ae*vf/1000 cm3/min; Pc = ap*ae*vf*kc/(60e6) kW; M = 9550*Pc/n
_formulas.tapping: n = 1000*vc/(pi*D); t = 2*(H + 2*P)/(P*n)  (in + out at the same speed)
_formulas.spindle_curve: available power P_av(n) = min(P_rated, M_max*n/9550); base speed n_b = 9550*P_rated/M_max; check Pc/eta <= P_av(n), eta = 0.8
_formulas.taylor_econ: T_min_cost = (1/n - 1)*(t_ct + K_t/(M/60)); T_max_prod = (1/n - 1)*t_ct; v = C/T^n  (M = machine+labour rate EUR/h, K_t = tool cost per edge EUR, t_ct = tool change time min)
_formulas.cooling_time: t_cool = s^2/(pi^2*alpha) * ln( (8/pi^2) * (T_m - T_w)/(T_e - T_w) )  [s; s in mm, alpha in mm2/s]
_formulas.clamp_force: F = p_cav * A_proj * safety  (bar*cm2 -> kN: 1 bar*cm2 = 0.01 kN)
_formulas.available_hours: days = 365 - weekend_days - holidays - shutdown_days; h = days*shifts*(shift_h - break_h); h_avail = h*(1 - planned_maint)
_formulas.load: L_g = sum Q_i*t_ig/60 + sum ceil(Q_i/lot_i)*t_setup_g/60 ; machines = ceil(L_g/(h_avail*OEE)) ; util = L_g/(machines*h_avail*OEE)
_formulas.eoq: Q* = sqrt(2*D*S/H); S = t_setup_h*rate + admin; H = holding_rate*unit_value; total cost = D/Q*S + Q/2*H
_formulas.line_balance_rpw: positional weight = own time + times of all (transitive) successors; assign tasks in descending weight (tie -> lower id) to the current station if all predecessors assigned and fits in takt, else open a new station; efficiency = sum t/(stations*takt); balance delay = 1 - efficiency; min stations = ceil(sum t/takt)
_formulas.ahp: weights = normalised geometric means of the rows of the pairwise matrix; lambda_max = mean over i of (A w)_i / w_i; CI = (lambda_max - n)/(n - 1); CR = CI/RI(n); RI = {1:0,2:0,3:0.58,4:0.90,5:1.12,6:1.24,7:1.32}; CR < 0.10 acceptable; score_alt = sum w_k * s_alt,k
_formulas.lcc: LCC = purchase + installation + sum_{t=1..years} (energy_t + maintenance_t + tooling_t)/(1+r)^t - residual/(1+r)^years ; energy_t = kW_avg*hours*price; maintenance_t = maint_pct*purchase

pfa._expected_from_item2_web: 3 cells, e = 27, exceptional 2 (P03->DRILL, P07->GRIND), voids 2, Gamma = 86.2 %
